Bench notes, January 2026 — raw, as recorded. Not a wiki page: no frontmatter,
no links to follow, never opened except for a verbatim quote or a question about
where a number came from.

---

08 Jan. 1:5:5 at 06:40, kitchen 21C. Domed and flat-topping by 13:10 — call it
6h30. Mixed 1000/700/20/200 at 13:30, dough 24C off the probe.

Coil folds 14:00, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30. Third one it finally held a seam.

Bulk called at 18:15 — a bit under 5h, marked 50% on the tape. Pre-shape 18:20,
bench rest 25 min, final shape 18:45, banneton into the fridge at 4C.

09 Jan. Out at 08:30 — 13h45 retard. Poke test came back halfway in about 3
seconds, scored cold, straight in.

Pot preheated from 07:30 at 250C. 20 lidded, then 22 at 230 uncovered. Probe
read 98C. Ear all the way down one side, crust blistered.

Cut at 11:00, so ~2h. Crumb open and irregular, no gum line.

Note to self: the 04 Jan loaf was the same dough but bulk called at 4h flat and
it came out dense with a blown side seam. Under-fermented, not under-proofed —
the rise was nowhere near 50%.
